shots.detail_en: Deep-night back room war room lit by one warm desk lamp; close-up of Wang Mancang in loud flower shirt licking a pen tip, hovering over a blank open roster notebook
shots.sub: 满仓：「第一个，王满仓——全仓入会，风险自担！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Extreme close-up: pen tip touches paper, the three characters WANG MANCANG written on the first line, ink slightly bleeding
Daytime, entrance of the old trading hall; retail investor A stands arms crossed, hesitating, taking half a step back
shots.sub: 散户甲：「上次妖股，我可亏麻了。」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Retail investor B stares at the roster in Mancang's hand, fingers rubbing the hem of his jacket nervously
shots.sub: 散户乙：「你们要是又骗我……」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Wide shot: Mancang pats his chest proudly with one hand and stuffs a small folding stool into investor A's arms
shots.sub: 满仓：「骗你我是煮熟的虾！亏了算我请喝一年汽水！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut montage 1: Mancang saves a seat for investor A in the crowded hall, pressing a hat onto the stool
Quick-cut montage 2: Mancang clinks soda bottles with investor B, bubbles fizzing up the glass
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Quick-cut montage 3: Mancang carries investor B's bicycle up the steps, grinning broadly
shots.sub: 满仓：「别客气，都是一个厅里的！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Night; under the desk lamp Shen Hongli shines a flashlight through a ledger page, revealing hidden watermark marks in the paper
shots.sub: 红利：「做局的钱怕光——我们照它。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Investor A leans close to the backlit ledger page and gasps; Hongli's fingertip steady on the paper
shots.sub: 散户甲：「账还能这么看？」红利：「数字自己会说话。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Round table in the back room at night; Changhong stands while Mancang and Hongli sit on both sides, investors A and B opposite; a roster lies open on the table
shots.sub: 长虹：「同盟只有一条铁规矩——信号响之前，谁都不许先跑。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: investor A stiffens his neck, unconvinced, glaring up
shots.sub: 散户甲：「跑不跑还得听你的？」
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Changhong calm and unhurried, fingertip pressing on the roster cover on the table
shots.sub: 长虹：「信号不是我的——是所有愿意不动的人，一起停住的那口气。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Close-up: investor A looks down at his own fist, crumpled then slowly loosening
Close-up: investor A takes the pen and signs a crooked name on the second line of the roster
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: Burst montage: roster pages flipping one by one, one page of names becomes a whole stack, flipping afterimages under the lamp
shots.sub: 旁白：「手写的名字，机器抄不走。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Overhead wide shot: stacks of rosters spread all over the round table under lamplight; Hongli and Mancang exchange a smile
Same night, second-floor machine room of the exchange; blue screen light on Xiong Wei's rimless glasses
Close-up of the screen: dots of light representing retail accounts ripple from scattered chaos gradually converging into one rhythm
shots.sub: 熊伟：「散户的节拍……在变齐。」
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Xiong Wei's fingertip pauses above the keyboard, lenses reflecting data light
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Medium shot: Xiong Wei opens a new hand-drawn style archive page on screen and types one line
Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「它算得准每一个人。」
